description_full: Navient Holdings, Inc. provides technology-enabled education finance for education in the United States. The company owns and manages portfolio of private education loans; and offers education lending and digital financial services, in-school student loans, and refinancing products under Earnest brand. It also owns Federal Family Education Loan Program (FFELP) loans that are insured or guaranteed by state or not-for-profit agencies; and performs servicing on its portfolios, as well as federal education loans held by other institutions. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Herndon, Virginia.

financial_summary: Navient Holdings, Inc. is a small-cap financial services business with a $584M market cap on $610M of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at -29% over the past three years, and a shrinking top line is the hardest headwind any business can overcome.
The business throws off $441M in free cash flow — roughly 72 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders.
Management returns a meaningful 29.8% of market cap to owners through dividends and buybacks, a strong signal of disciplined capital allocation, and insiders hold 2.3% of the shares.
